edge_cases: n=2048 = 32 HVX vectors of 64 fp16 lanes (clean single-tile size, no remainder)
no-mean-sub RMSNorm (only sum-of-squares, no mean subtraction, no beta)
x[0]=3.0, x[1]=-3.0 (extremes at the head of the reduction)
per-feature gamma (0.5..1.5 cycling, != 1 for most indices) is a runtime array, must be read (anti-hardcode)
inv_rms computed as an O(1) scalar from a vectorized O(n) reduction (single scalar sqrtf call, not per-element)
HVX qf16 arithmetic is non-IEEE -> tolerance compare, not bit-exact
omitted-gamma near-miss must fail (gamma is pinned != 1 for most indices)
name: fp16_rmsnorm
signal: compute-bound reduction + elementwise scale (HVX qf16 vs scalar fp16)
